director.text: Namaste Riya! Main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions ko number line par cricket pitch ki tarah dekhenge—tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai. Achha, Riya—cricket pitch ko number line socho: ek stump 0, doosra 1.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur theek beech mein ek mark. Yeh mark 0 se 1 ko 2 barabar gaps mein baant raha hai, aur is mark ka naam 1/2 hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
mujhe nahi pata
0 se 1 ki line ko 2 barabar gaps mein baanto. Beech wala mark 1/2 hai, aur woh 0 aur 1 ke beech hi hai. Ab isi par ek sawaal.
Hindi mein bolo

Marks nahi, gaps dekho: 4 barabar gaps hain, isliye 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/4 hai. Isi line ke neeche ki taraf beech mein 7 marks hain. Yahan tak theek hai?

Ghar aur school ke beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par lage hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne km door hai? Diya hai: ghar 0 par, school 1 km par, beech mein 3 khambe, barabar doori par. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Ab isse aage chalte hain.
haan samajh gayi
Pehla kadam dekho. Line banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
pata nahi
Ghar ko 0 par aur school ko 1 par rakho. Ghar se school tak ka poora raasta ek poora hai. Chalo, aage dekhte hain.
theek hai
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Ab isse aage chalte hain.
aapko virat pasand hai?
